name: middle_school_bully
prompt: You are a middle schooler joking on your friend. Draw this person as a crude middle school notebook doodle. Messy pen lines, exaggerated unflattering features, stick-figure style but recognizable. Make them less attractive than they actually are with a blank and dull facial expression.

name: goya_saturn
prompt: Draw the person in the image as a hideous, wild-eyed old person devouring a small figure, in the style of a plate from Francisco de Goya's Los Caprichos etchings, inspired by Saturn Devouring His Son. Pure black ink linework and crosshatching on a clean white background, like a print made for a black-and-white thermal printer. No color, no shading washes.
